author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@GauthRaj What city?The first thing you do is focus on your own house and then start to help building the village. So for example instead of just having a @medium blog create your own website and then syndicate to other folks. In the #indieweb model this is called POSSE. Publish on your Own Site Syndicate Elsewhere.

Let me know if you need any help. In terms of dev contributions I would suggest lurking in the dev channel of chat to learn the repos and which have bugs or need for community development.
